# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

This repository holds the documentation for pgEdge Starfleet. Report a
security problem in the documentation itself — a page that publishes a
credential, or one that presents an insecure practice as recommended —
the same way you would report one in a pgEdge product.

**Do not open a public issue.**

Email security@pgedge.com with:

- The affected page, or its path under `docs/`
- A description of the problem
- The potential impact
- A suggested fix, if you have one

We will acknowledge receipt within 48 hours and give an estimated
timeline for a fix.

## Scope

This site is built and served by the pgEdge console. A
vulnerability in the console, or in any other pgEdge product, goes to
the same address rather than to this repository's issue tracker.
